extension.summary: Fullscreen XMLTV guide — artwork-only Beta successor; runtime unchanged.
extension.description: Maintained modernization Beta of TV Guide Fullscreen: XMLTV listings, stream mappings, search, reminders and ordinary AutoPlay. Bounded Nexus 20.5 core evidence is reused for unchanged code; audio, timer delivery and broader compatibility remain limited. Thanks for the major contributions from: iainmacleod, im85288, RayW1986, bluezed, andy, Zomboided, tycoo, kjb86, Doctor-Eggs
extension.disclaimer: Based on the original TV Guide addon by twinther, FTV Guide and Midraal's fork.
extension.news: 0.1.1 Beta: artwork-only successor; runtime unchanged. Original geometric icon/fanart replace inherited Earth images; four promotional screenshots omitted, channel-management capture retained. Reuses bounded Nexus 20.5 code evidence, not new native ZIP/upgrade/repository UI acceptance. Audio UNTESTED; optional timed notification and actual timer-fired AutoPlay UNOBSERVED; logs non-clean. Inherited static gate FAIL; other beta lanes deferred. See the maintained fork README for status and artwork provenance.
